# What strategy did you use during the game?

- How did you decide on your strategy?
- Did you change your strategy? If so, when? How?

Please use at least 200 characters.
prompt_strategy.value: I used sort of an association strategy. If a figure was mostly green, i labeled it "green." If a figure looked like a bird, I called it "bird." I was also very open to the other person's ideas as well.

prompt_mistake.name: mistake
prompt_mistake.prompt:
# Describe the reasons for any mistakes

Did you make any mistakes in remembering the names you gave to the images?

If so, please describe what you think caused them. For example, typos, mixing up similar images, etc. 

If you didn't make any mistakes, you can type "none".
prompt_mistake.value: I did make a mistake once. I gave an answer of "sit" for one of the geometrical black figures. I don't remember seeing that figure before the quiz, so I just had to guess. I also got a lot of them wrong, simply because my teammate was having connection issues and wasn't present for many of the discussions. As a result, he wasn't able to discuss ideas with me. During the quiz, he obviously did not put an answer, so i got those wrong by default.

prompt_working_together.name: working_together
prompt_working_together.prompt:
# How did you and your partner divide the work of coming up with names?

For example, did you both suggest names, take turns, have one person take the lead, or use some other approach?
prompt_working_together.value: We just bounced ideas off each other. I typically "took charge" and gave some ideas, and he was able to add his own suggestions as well. I was very flexible and so was he.
